messages.subject: GCC Energy & Natural Resources Leadership | Government Relations, ESG and Country Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Bradley,

I am reaching out because your Dubai-based work across energy, infrastructure, mining and metals, sustainability, and Middle East leadership aligns closely with the executive mandates I am pursuing across the GCC.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit sits at the intersection of country operations, government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, external and corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, and executive advisory within a major gold-mining environment.

My recent work includes senior engagement with ministries and regulators, cross-functional coordination on complex operating and reputation matters, support for a large-scale solar and battery-storage platform, and carbon-accounting work linked to operating data and governance. Across 12+ years, I have built experience spanning multinational mining, regulated financial services, and commercial operations.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Country Leadership, External or Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Chief of Staff, and Executive Operations mandates across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain, and Kuwait. Mining, natural resources, energy transition, infrastructure, and industrial businesses represent my strongest fit.

I would welcome consideration for current or upcoming searches where a globally mobile, country-facing executive profile fits the mandate. My Gulf-focused executive CV is attached.

Preferred reply/contact: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
